nodes.odmowa.text.t: "The wagon stands, the horse eats, and I pay for both. Don't keep me waiting long."

nodes.prosba.text.t: "My brother-in-law's still waiting on the pass, and I owe him more than this cloth is worth. I won't get there alone, that much I know. Same forty groats. Coming?"

nodes.zgoda.text.t: "Then I'm hitching up before I change my mind. Or you change yours."
